headline: Tabled approval of draft minutes; discussed selection criteria and applicant communication for board and commission appointments.
summary: The committee discussed how board and commission appointments are selected, including dual appointments, incumbency, and a standardized rubric. Members also discussed the lack of communication with applicants after they submit applications. The committee unanimously voted to table adoption of draft minutes.
decisions: Tabled adoption of the draft minutes from September 17, 2026 until the next meeting, unanimously.

Page 1 of 2 
 
 
Charter Change Committee 
 Thursday, October 15, 2026 
Remote via Zoom/In-Person in Sharon Bushor Conference Room, 1st Floor, City Hall, 
Burlington, Vermont   
DRAFT MINUTES 
  
Members Present:  Becca Brown McKnight (Chair), Gene Bergman, Buddy Singh 
  
Staff Present: Jessica Brown (City Attorney) 
 
Public Present: None 
 
Meeting called to order at 12:02 PM by Councilor McKnight. 
  
1.   Adopt the Agenda 
     1.01 Adopt the Agenda 
  
Motion to Adopt Agenda as written.  
 
Motion by Councilor Bergman, Seconded by Councilor Singh 
Final Resolution: Motion Passes 
Yes: Unanimous 
 
2.   Adopt the Minutes 
     2.01 Motion to adopt draft minutes from September 17, 2026 
  
Motion to table adoption of the draft minutes from September 17, 2026 until the next Charter 
Change Committee meeting.   
 
Motion by Councilor Bergman, Seconded by Councilor Singh 
Final Resolution: Motion Passes 
Yes: Unanimous 
 
3.    Public Forum 
      3.01 Verbal Comments 
 
There were no speakers present.   
 
Public forum closed at 12:07 PM.   
 
4.    Board and Commission Appointment Process 
      4.01 Board and Commission Appointment Process 
 
Councilor Bergman requested a memo and email communications relevant to the charter change 
item discussion be posted for any future meetings on this topic, along with the Boards and 
Commissions reference chart.
Page 2 of 2 
 
 
 
Chair Brown McKnight noted wanting to hear from City staff who could speak to the boards and 
commission appointment process from the City’s perspective. 
 
The Committee discussed selection criteria, including the rules around dual appointments and 
elected officials’ eligibility: 
• Chair Brown McKnight requested Charter Section 131 be added to the next agenda for 
reference.   
• Councilor Singh mentioned exploring incumbency as a criterion.   
• Chair Brown McKnight brought up a standardized rubric.   
• Councilor Bergman emphasized commissioners having the right mix of experience and 
understanding, that incumbency can be a double-edged sword, and thinks a more 
comprehensive application process would be more effective to make fair decisions on 
candidates than a rubric.   
• Councilor Singh asked for clarification from the Mayor’s Office on the intent of the 
memo’s request about transparency in candidate selection.   
• Chair Brown McKnight requested the application template be added to the next agenda 
and that not all boards and commissions need technical expertise, and therefore 
commissioners with relevant experience, to be effective.  Councilor Bergman agreed and 
suggested that the applications could be more personalized to each board and 
commission.   
 
The Committee moved on to discuss the applicant experience: 
• Councilor Singh shared his perspective on the application process, stating that once the 
application was submitted, there was no communication through the rest of the process 
until the point of approval.  He also noted there is no protocol for councilors to reach out 
to applicants, but some may, so the expectation is unclear. 
 
5.  Adjournment 
     5.01 Motion to adjourn 
 
The meeting was adjourned with no objection at 1:01 PM.
